verdict.rationale: Replit's Design space (replit-docs-6) lets users visually explore/tweak designs and apply them directly to the app, and templates preserve visual design with direct editing (replit-docs-15, replit-docs-22), suggesting some direct visual manipulation without a prompt round-trip. However, evidence doesn't confirm a true click-to-select element inspector with inline text/style/layout editing akin to a design tool; most workflows still describe Agent-mediated changes. missing for 10: explicit documentation of selecting a live element and editing its text/style/layout directly, independent/hands-on confirmation that no prompt is needed, and detail on the scope of the 'Design space' editing capabilities.
